name: Becky Hadlock
occupation: Former Weston County clerk (won the November 2022 general election; resigned April 9, 2026)
prior_offices: Weston County clerk (won the November 2022 general election; served until her resignation effective April 9, 2026)
background: Becky Hadlock served as Weston County clerk after winning the November 2022 general election. The News Letter Journal reported that in a resignation letter dated April 9, 2026, she resigned effective immediately, and that the resignation came one day after she was formally charged in Weston County Circuit Court with violation of election code by an official and falsifying election documents, both felonies; the article quoted her letter as stating that she intended to focus on personal matters, including the criminal charges filed against her. WyoFile reported that a separate civil case seeking her removal from office was dismissed after the resignation, and that the Weston County Commissioners declared the office vacant on April 14, 2026. The criminal charges are allegations reported in those accounts; no conviction was found in the public records reviewed for this Profile.
